28 weeks = 28 × 7 = 196 days.  
Add 6 days → total 202 days.  
2001-09-06 + 202 days:  
September: 30 - 6 = 24 days used → 202 - 24 = 178 left.  
October: 31 days → 178 - 31 = 147 left.  
November: 30 → 147 - 30 = 117 left.  
December: 31 → 117 - 31 = 86 left.  
2002: January 31 → 86 - 31 = 55 left.  
February 28 (2002 not leap) → 55 - 28 = 27 left.  
March 27 days → 2002-03-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2002-03-27
